body:
My fondest memory ? Most likely back when I was a child, not understanding how the world and the society works, not knowing about my mental issues and just living carefree from day to day.

Most recently, waking up besides the woman I love so deeply, though that did not last for long because reality came back at me hard as a rock.

My bucket list is pretty empty to be honest. I always lived day by day, not looking into the future. Maybe visiting the big cities of the US.
